Tenant B's public web (10.201.1.0/24) is being moved to a CDN: remove it from PL_PUBLIC on border1 and border2 so it is no longer announced to the WAN. wan-user1 will lose access to web-b1; web-a1 stays published.

--- a/configs/border1.cfg

@@ -45,5 +45,4 @@
  redistribute ospf route-map RM_TO_WAN
 !
-ip prefix-list PL_PUBLIC seq 5 permit 10.101.1.0/24
 ip prefix-list PL_PUBLIC seq 10 permit 10.201.1.0/24
 !
--- a/configs/border2.cfg
+++ b/configs/border2.cfg
@@ -45,5 +45,4 @@
  redistribute ospf route-map RM_TO_WAN
 !
-ip prefix-list PL_PUBLIC seq 5 permit 10.101.1.0/24
 ip prefix-list PL_PUBLIC seq 10 permit 10.201.1.0/24
 !
